headline: Nitemary soul collector
title: Nitemary | Handiwork Four And More Pal Souls | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a top crafter that also helps your Pal Soul farming? Nitemary is a Dark Pal with Handiwork level four and Transporting level two. Its partner skill, Soul Collector, makes Pals drop more Pal Souls when defeated while you fight together. It is a nocturnal Pal, so plan your base shifts. Will you take Nitemary to your next soul farm? Comment below!
description: Nitemary in Palworld 1.0 is a Dark Pal with Handiwork level four and a partner skill that increases Pal Soul drops.
